title: New CI demo-no-network grep step fails on the shipped tree — the `^import api/` ban catches demo_api.gleam's type-only api_error import
evidence: workflow: `VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "api_helpers\|^import api/" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" || true)` then `if [ -n "$VIOLATIONS" ] ... exit 1`. Tree: `client/src/demo/demo_api.gleam:18:import api/api_error.{type ApiError}`. Executing the exact workflow shell locally prints `WORKFLOW STEP WOULD FAIL: client/src/demo/demo_api.gleam:18:import api/api_error.{type ApiError}`.
detail: The r3-hardened lint step cannot pass on the very tree it ships with: the pattern meant to ban the API-client layer also matches a type-only error import. The step was never executed against the tree (CI billing-blocked, no Makefile target).
recommended_fix: Narrow the ban to the transport layer (e.g. `^import api/api_helpers` plus the verb modules), or exempt api_error explicitly, then run the step once locally to confirm it passes.

title: Cross-arm guard bleed NOT fixed in lint_demo_network.py — the r2#11 window-scoping fix did not bite (verified by synthetic violation)
evidence: `window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx])` / `guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window` — the window is still a raw 35-line lookback, not scoped to the enclosing arm. Reproduced: injected `let _ = payment_api.checkout_status("sess", on_response: ApiReturnedPaymentPoll)` as the first line of the `UserChangedSignupName(name) -> {` arm (not in EXEMPT_ARMS/DEMO_INTERCEPTED, no demo guard in-arm) — `python3 lint_demo_network.py` exits 0.
detail: The r3 briefing's claimed 'cross-arm guard does NOT satisfy' bite-test fails: a guard 17 lines up in the unrelated BrowserChangedUrl arm satisfies an unguarded call in a fresh arm. Per the round's fix-audit bar, a fix that didn't bite is a new blocker.
recommended_fix: Record the arm-boundary line index during the scope walk and clip the guard window to lines[arm_start:idx]; re-run the synthetic cross-arm violation and require exit 1.

title: model.gleam: policy_reaccept_required's doc block got detached onto clear_demo_state, leaving policy_reaccept_required undocumented
evidence: `/// Comparison is lexical — `policy_version` is ISO-8601 (`"YYYY-MM-DD"`)` ... `/// (possible after a deliberate server rollback) is trusted.` immediately followed by `/// Exit demo mode cleanly: drop the demo flag, store and mock session, AND` then `pub fn clear_demo_state(model: Model) -> Model {` ... then a bare `pub fn policy_reaccept_required(model: Model) -> Bool {` with no doc comment.
detail: The insertion of clear_demo_state split the doc comment from its function: the 'True when the landlord must re-accept...' block (7 lines) now documents the wrong function and the policy gate lost its documentation.
recommended_fix: Move clear_demo_state (with its own doc) above the `/// True when the landlord must re-accept` block so the policy doc reattaches to policy_reaccept_required.

title: pdf_prebake still ships the r2#20 unused imports (gleam/result, GetDocumentsByApplicationRow, GetIncomeSourcesByApplicationRow)
evidence: `type GetDocumentsByApplicationRow, type GetIncomeSourcesByApplicationRow,` (line 23) and `import gleam/result` (line 31); grep confirms zero `result.` call sites in the file and the two type names appear only in the import list.
detail: r2 finding 20 ('drop the two unused type imports and gleam/result') did not land — compiler warnings persist on new code.
recommended_fix: Remove the two unused type imports and `import gleam/result`.

title: demo_fixtures.result_to_seed_error is a zero-caller export (r2#19 orphan residual)
evidence: `pub fn result_to_seed_error(result: Result(a, String)) -> Result(a, SeedError) {` — grep across client/src and client/test finds references only for sibling `seed_error_from_result` (demo_store.gleam:151-163); result_to_seed_error has no non-definition reference.
detail: The r2 dead-export fold left one orphan helper in the reworked fixtures module.
recommended_fix: Delete result_to_seed_error (or wire it into the store seed path if a String-error decode remains).

title: lint_demo_network DEMO_BRANCHED_HELPERS comment is false for three of eight helpers — they carry no demo branch
evidence: lint: `# Helpers that branch on demo_mode internally (verified to carry the store).` listing fire_refcheck_slot_action / fire_refcheck_call_action / save_refcheck_edit. client.gleam: `fn fire_refcheck_slot_action(` body is `case find_refcheck_call ... fire(vid, aid, slot, model.csrf_token, ...)` — no `model.demo_mode` anywhere in these three function bodies (verified by reading each body).
detail: These helpers are demo-safe only because callers pass a demo `fire` or the triggering message sits in DEMO_INTERCEPTED; the lint's stated invariant is wrong, so future refactors guided by the comment could allowlist an unsafe helper.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to state these helpers are demo-safe via injected `fire` + caller interception, or add a real demo branch.

title: DEMO_INTERCEPTED ↔ demo_update.handle sync is still comment-only — no mechanical cross-check despite the r3 'manifest drift' claim
evidence: `# Messages whose real arms in update_inner are unreachable in demo mode` / `# because demo/demo_update.gleam intercepts them and resolves from the` / `# in-memory store. Keep this in sync with the request messages in` / `# demo_update.handle — a message listed here must have a demo arm there.` — the script contains no code parsing demo_update.gleam; drift is caught only accidentally when the real arm is also unwindowed (a removed entry failed my synthetic test only because that arm's call is unguarded).
detail: The r3 claim of a manifest-drift bite holds only incidentally; a manifest entry for a demo-armed message can drift silently, and a stale entry masks a missing demo interception forever.
recommended_fix: Parse demo/demo_update.gleam arm heads and assert DEMO_INTERCEPTED equals the intercepted set (fail on both directions of drift).
